finding: Across non-reset captures, TV80 I/O read assertions precede C by one fixture cycle and write assertions follow C by two. A shared reset near a write edge therefore interrupts a different number of bits. Both cores recover and produce the same subsequent frame.
rejectedCandidate: TV80 T2Write=1 aligns every recorded serial edge in the near-reset fixture, but changes bit values. Earlier assertion without qualified data setup is not a remedy. Production and vendored cores remain unchanged.
observationBoundary: A final HDL LED edge at the excluded stop cycle is retained outside the half-open capture interval. This corrects the observation window without suppressing interior timing or value differences.
nextProof: Qualify joint address/data/control timing against CPU bus-cycle requirements, including data setup/hold, read sampling, wait states and reset edges, before changing either CPU boundary. A constant log shift cannot reconcile the differing read/write offsets.

reference.scope: Independent Z80 I/O-cycle requirements; not U880 specimen calibration.
